$comment: Declarative composition of each hiking day from the OSM geometry.
tools/split_legs.py reads this and emits data/route/legs/*.json.
Anchors are projected perpendicularly onto the main loop, so they only need
to be close to the trail, not exactly on it. Check the reported offset when
adding one: anything over ~250 m means the anchor is probably in the wrong
valley and the resulting leg boundary will be wrong.
hike    - walked. Either a slice of the main loop between two anchors,
or a whole named variant relation (auto-oriented to connect).
transit - bus / navette / lift / train. Carries distance for reference but
is excluded from hiking totals and from the walking-time model.
plannedTotals mirrors the group's original spreadsheet so the UI can show
computed figures next to the numbers the trip was scoped against.

courmayeur.name: Courmayeur
courmayeur.note: The main itinerary passes above the town rather than through the centre, so the leg boundary sits at the trail's closest approach (~390 m north).

la-fouly.name: La Fouly
la-fouly.note: Still a stage stop on the trail and the midpoint of day 4, but no longer a night — the group walks or rides through it.

le-tour.name: Le Tour
le-tour.note: Reached via the Le Tour variant relation, not the main itinerary — the main route stays high over the Aiguillette des Posettes toward Tré-le-Champ.

les-mottets.name: Les Mottets
les-mottets.note: Refuge des Mottets, 1,870 m. The navette from Les Chapieux terminates at Ville des Glaciers just below; it is a short road walk up to here before the Col de la Seigne climb begins.

lac-combal.name: Lac Combal
lac-combal.note: Val Veni bus stop at the Combal dam

arnouvaz.name: Arnouvaz
arnouvaz.note: Top of the Val Ferret bus line

chamonix.name: Chamonix-Mont-Blanc
chamonix.note: Trip base. Not on the trail — reached by bus or train.

segments.note: Les Chapieux navette, ~€5 return. Road closed to cars 07:30–18:00. Tickets sell out — buy the evening before at the machine by Auberge de la Nova.
Val Veni summer bus down to Courmayeur

days.note: One calendar day because there is no La Fouly night booked. The two halves used to be day 4 and day 5; walked end to end it is the longest stage of the trip by a wide margin, which is what the variant toggle is for.

segments.note: Val Ferret bus (SVAP/Arriva, Alta Valle timetable) up to Arnouvaz
TMR post bus down the Swiss Val Ferret and back up to Champex, changing at Orsières

arpette.label: Fenêtre d'Arpette variant
arpette.note: The high, hard alternative to the Bovine route. 2,665 m col with the Trient Glacier head-on — the standout photographic objective of the Swiss section.

segments.note: Chamonix Bus line 1, free with the Carte d'Hôte from any valley accommodation

classic.label: Classic TMB
classic.note: Full final stage via Tré-le-Champ, La Flégère and Le Brévent, then transit back to Chamonix.
